buildCommand: node scripts/prepare-prisma-for-postgres.mjs && prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma && bash -c 'if [ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]; then prisma db push --accept-data-loss --skip-generate --schema=prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma; else echo "[build] DATABASE_URL not set — skipping prisma db push (app will 500 on DB-backed routes until env is configured)"; fi' && next build
